title: PE’s certificate table directory uses file offset
summary: The attribute certificate table is not loaded as a regular image section, and the address field of the Security Directory represents the file location.
detail: This offset and size can be checked directly in the original file range when parsing the certificate table; mapping it again by RVA would be off target.
boundary: This is a directory-specific exception, and the address of an import table or export table cannot be interpreted as a file offset accordingly.
relevance: Determine whether the signature data still belongs to the legal file content when it is located after the last section.
